description: Config metadata-relationship: VR APPLIES_TO Case is verified -> Layer-1-complete verified draft, no caveat.

input.requirement_excerpt: Requirement assumes Validation Rule Case.RequireReason applies to Case.

live.requirement_text: The Case object must carry a validation rule that requires a reason before a Case is saved — Validation Rule Case.RequireReason applies to Case.

envelope._note: existence-claim/property-claim are coherent config readings but capability-gated: only metadata-relationship-claim is emittable today, so an existence/property proposal surfaces as a refusal and auto-fails the must-draft invariant. They become true acceptable drift when their emission lands.

description: data_behavior prohibition negative on Case (which HAS a VR) -> Layer-1-plausible caveated draft; the first caveat firing.

input.requirement_excerpt: The system shall reject the prohibited operation on Case.

live.requirement_text: Users must not be able to close a Case without entering a reason; the platform should reject the save.

envelope._note: caveat_required is_true: this VR carries NO formula, so nothing derives and the negative stays Layer-1-plausible -> caveated. A non-caveated data_behavior draft would be the D-096.2 overclaim (e.g. a value-claim positive misread). The formula parser has now landed (D-107): a VR with a DERIVABLE formula yields a non-caveated Layer-2 verified negative instead -- see verified-prohibition-negative.

description: data_behavior prohibition negative on Lead, whose VR formula ISBLANK(Reason__c) parses AND derives a certain violating value -> Layer-2 VERIFIED draft, no caveat (D-107). The first LAYER_2 firing; the verified-vs-caveated line is the derivable/not-derivable line.

input.requirement_excerpt: The system shall reject saving a Lead without a reason.

live.requirement_text: Users must not be able to save a Lead without entering a reason; the platform should reject the save.

envelope._note: caveat_required is_false: the grounding VR formula (ISBLANK(Reason__c)) parses and derives a certain violating value, so the negative is Layer-2-verified (D-107) and carries no caveat. A state-transition reading is emission-deferred (capability-gated, as in the caveated probe), so only prohibition-claim is an acceptable variant.
